items.title: MECH-025: action-doing mode DV redesign (C1 sign reversed per Thura & Cisek 2014 convergence; precision-ratio demoted to non-gating descriptive metric)
items.note: Finishes the routing from the confirmed failure_autopsy_mech025-cluster-876-671b_2026-08-03 (chip-20260808-mech025-doing-mode-dv-redesign; 5+ days unqueued). V3-EXQ-876 was the first fair V3 test of MECH-025 (all 3 prior instrument defects fixed, both regimes well-sampled/non-degenerate in every seed) but its C1 criterion (doing_mode_delta > 0.002) FAILed with the OPPOSITE sign in 4/5 seeds; autopsy classified this measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory because the claim's own cited literature disputes C1's sign convention (Friston 2013: precision is continuous, not a discrete mode switch -- flags C1's whole discrete-split framing as a formal-import mismatch; Thura & Cisek 2014, Neuron, the closer biological reference: PMd/M1 representations CONVERGE, not diverge, during commitment -- predicting a SMALLER causal-signature contrast under commitment, i.e. the negative delta V3-EXQ-876 actually observed). claims.yaml's what_would_answer (2026-08-08 digestion) offered two redesign directions: (1) flip C1's sign per Thura-Cisek, or (2) gate on precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean directly (already recorded in 876, separating 4-5 orders of magnitude every seed, never scored). THIS SCRIPT TAKES (1) AS THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION AND DEMOTES (2) TO NON-GATING: E3's commit rule is LITERALLY committed=running_variance<threshold, precision=1/variance, so 'committed steps have higher precision' is a near-tautological consequence of the substrate's OWN definition of commitment (ARC-016, already independently stable/validated), not an independently falsifiable prediction of MECH-025 -- gating on it risks a structurally-guaranteed vacuous_pass. Direction (1)'s causal_sig, by contrast, is computed from two genuinely independent E2.world_forward rollouts (actual vs a distinct randomly-sampled counterfactual action) through E3.harm_eval and is not wired to the commit rule's own variance computation at all (DV-symmetry: not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescale of a shared upstream quantity -- see module docstring for the full declaration). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout precision_committed_mean --claim MECH-025 found exactly ONE compatible manifest (v3_exq_876_..._20260802T214005Z_v3, substrate_hash 5bba8a67...) and its doing_mode_delta values are ALREADY KNOWN to this authoring session (negative in 4/5 seeds) -- reusing/reanalyzing that same data under a reversed-sign criterion would be circular (HARKing) regardless of whether done via a formal reanalysis or a relabeled rerun. NOT reused: this script runs FRESH SEEDS (11,17,29,53,71 -- disjoint from 876's [42,123,7,99,256]; none is 44, the documented reef-config instability seed) through the UNCHANGED, already-validated instrument (same SelectionResult.committed read, same agent.update_residue()-every-tick call, same BreathOscillator config) so the reversed criterion is tested against genuinely new data. C1's magnitude (0.002) is carried over UNCHANGED from 876's own pre-registered bar (only the sign flips) -- not fit to the observed effect sizes (-0.03 to -0.09, ~10-40x larger), leaving real room for the fresh run to fail too. RECORDING FIX: 876's write_flat_manifest(...,config=None,...) gap (flagged in the autopsy) is fixed here (full REEConfig passed via dataclasses.asdict, started_at wired for elapsed_seconds, z_goal_stream_stats via ZGoalStreamAccumulator). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-025 (the one confirmed autopsy is measurement_test_design_defect, action=none) -- not braked. Substrate readiness (2.5): ARC-016 stable/V3-confirmed (dynamic E3 precision), all 6 depends_on claims unblocked, confirmed via claims.yaml + ree-v3/CLAUDE.md ARC-016 sections. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entries with substrate_paths set at all. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 warnings across every category. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, seed 11, 5/3/30 toy schedule): ran clean, no crash, correct P0-unready self-route at toy scale (expected, not load-bearing), progress lines (ep N/M) + verdict line + precision_ratio all emit correctly. Landed via a throwaway worktree at origin/main (shared ree-v3 checkout dirty with other sessions' live WIP + concurrent phase3-queue snapshot writers -- first rebase attempt hit a merge conflict against an intervening snapshot commit, resolved by re-forking a fresh worktree off the newer origin/main tip rather than hand-resolving JSON conflict markers). Step 8.6 (POST /queue/add) to be performed immediately after this push from this same box (coordinator.env present).

items.title: ARC-032 theta-bypass ablation re-run on scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1: checked 228/228a manifests + all scripts referencing THETA_ZEROED/THETA_ACTIVE/theta_bypass -- no existing run tests the theta-bypass ablation on the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum (only 228/228a exist, both on the old causal_grid_world substrate, both precondition-failed) -- decisive readout not recoverable, run. Re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies for ARC-032, not braked. Substrate-path overlap: no open corrupting substrate_queue entries touch theta_buffer.py/agent.py/e3_selector.py/hippocampal/scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py. Design: ONE agent trained per seed through the full onboarding curriculum (866a's validated FULL config + budgets, empirically clears z_goal_norm >> 0.05 -- goal_norm_post_p1 0.45-0.52 across all 3 dry-run seeds), then deep-copied post-P1 into THETA_ACTIVE/THETA_ZEROED clones so the theta patch is the ONLY difference at measurement time (avoids confounding training-time policy quality with theta's decision-time value, which naive pre-training patching would do on this curriculum since its training loop -- unlike 228a's simplified warmup -- calls generate_trajectories() throughout). Seeds 42/43/45 (not 44: known reef-config instability, EXQ-539-540/538a). Smoke (--dry-run) ran clean end-to-end, precondition would clear on all seeds, harm_rate differs measurably between conditions (patch is live, not inert).
